title: Decent gift set;  hate the smell of the Tea Tree Oil soap; everything else nice
text:
Decent gift set; hate the smell of the Tea Tree Oil soap; everything else nice. This is a nice Christmas gift box. There are the following 10 items included excluding the nice magnetic gift box itself:

- a extra package of shredded paper (not sure why that is needed)

- tiny blank greeting card

- stainless steel coffee mug with Merry Christmas written the front and a green pine needle with berry design

- reusable stainless Christmas green steel drinking straw with filter spoon (this is the kind that is usually used with a mate cup)

- two bath bombs in green tea tree oil fragrance

- one tiny bar of soap that smells strongly of tea tree oil - extremely overpowering; I hate it

-one lovely lavender candle in a nice Christmas tin

- a green velvet hair tie with antlers

- one pair of green Santa Claus Christmas stocks

The arrangement is nice and the candle and green straw are my favorite items. The current price of $34.99 ($39.99 minus $5) comes to $3.50 per item which is on the high side of competitively priced.

The biggest negative about this entire ensemble is the awful smelling bar of soap. Since the ingredients are in an Asian language, I have no idea what the fragrance is but at first I thought it was Eucalyptus then I realized it smelled more like tea tree oil. It is super intense and overpowers the aroma coming out of the box as soon as it is opened. Also the extra package of nesting material is ridiculous as a gift item.
